items.title: What is A2UI?
items.text: A declarative protocol for agents to describe UI as JSON that a client renders with its own components.

items.title: Fixed vs dynamic schema
items.text: Fixed: the tree is pre-authored and the agent streams data. Dynamic: a sub-agent composes the tree per request.

items.title: Does it stream?
items.text: Yes. Components paint as they arrive over AG-UI.
